item.title: Agency, Ego, and Enjoyment: Rethinking My TTRPGs and Myself
item.description: Hi all, it has been a while. A lot has happened in the years I did not write for my blog, like graduating and relationship things. I would like to write about the journey I went on playing roleplaying games and what I have personally learnt from them. See this as a journey throughout my experience with tabletop roleplaying games, but also as a vent piece. I just need to get things off my head. The post might feel aimless, and I am aware of this, this is more for me.
